posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: I am now heading to China, from the Philippines, where we had a wonderful meeting on Trade, National Security, and other subjects. I am pleased to announce that we made a new and completely different Trade Deal with the Philippines, one that will be a true landmark and, in particular, a Deal that will be great for our Farmers and those in the business of “Energy.” President Marcos is a powerful leader, and a man of high integrity and substance. It was an Honor to be with him, and his beautiful wife and son. See you in China! President DONALD J. TRUMP

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Anthropic shares will begin publicly trading today in a market debut that may test the strength of the AI boom.

Anthropic will release more shares than initially planned and raised the price, indicating strong interest from investors.
posts.text_ko:
Anthropic 주식은 AI 붐의 힘을 시험할 수 있는 시장 데뷔로 오늘부터 공개 거래를 시작할 것입니다.

앤트로픽은 당초 계획보다 더 많은 주식을 발행하고 가격도 인상할 예정이어서 투자자들의 높은 관심을 엿볼 수 있다.

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
The number of Muslims worldwide is on the cusp of surpassing the number of Christians, according to a new study.

And the U.S. will no longer be majority-Christian by 2070, the research shows. https://wapo.st/4t3SK8k
posts.text_ko:
새로운 연구에 따르면 전 세계적으로 이슬람교도의 수가 기독교인의 수를 넘어설 위기에 처해 있습니다.

그리고 연구에 따르면 2070년에는 미국이 더 이상 대다수 기독교인이 아닐 것이라고 합니다. https://wapo.st/4t3SK8k
